justification: Both surfaces depict a horned quadruped in profile, but A shows a naturalistic, detailed procession of human attendants leading rams with fleece texture and modelled curling horns, while B shows only a crude, isolated schematic outline of an animal-like form with linear appendages and no human figures or narrative context. The correspondence is limited to the near-universal motif of a profile animal, with utterly different rendering conventions (high-relief naturalism versus rough incised linework) and no shared relationships or composition.
